name: ProductAnswer
summary: Presents the products a lookup found in the Pilar da Terra (VR Master) registration with how each criterion was understood.

props.name: answer
props.meaning: Generated SDK agent result: each criterion with the records or classification paths it resolved to, exclusions and the business rule of its relationship; counts per section, notes, the exact total and up to 200 products.

accessibility: A group named by its level-2 source heading; criteria in a description list; a native captioned table with scoped headers that states when only the first products are listed.
usage: Render only validated API results. Always show the interpretation beside the list: classification paths, exclusions and relationship rules are how a person checks what was selected.

examples.label: Category with an exclusion
examples.description: Synthetic classification paths and products; the preview makes no API, provider or ERP request.
